chip.description: SMPC (System Manager & Peripheral Control) of the Sega Saturn and ST-V: pad/peripheral interfacing, reset and power management and the real-time clock, implemented as a Hitachi HD404920FS 4-bit MCU carrying a Sega custom part number.
chip.notes: Identification from MAME src/mame/sega/smpc.cpp: 'The SMPC is actually a 4-bit Hitachi HD404920FS MCU, labeled with a Sega custom 315-5744'. TB2: mask-programmed on-die ROM, so mcu.
